input.summary: Cap set at greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000; payment carve-out broadened to amounts due.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000; as drafted the basis is illusory because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form. We have reset the cap basis in § 21.1 and broadened the § 21.3 payment carve-out to amounts due, leaving the mutual cap, the mutual exclusion of indirect damages and the Excluded Claims carve-outs untouched.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages
ops.newText: Customer's obligation to pay amounts due under this Agreement and any Order Form is not damages
